extracted text: The crystallization temperature used was 175 °C. The structure directing agent used was N(16)-methyl-sparteinium (MSPT). In a typical synthesis, a solution of N(16)-methyl-sparteinium hydroxide, Ludox AS-40 (colloidal silica, 40 wt% suspension in water), germanium oxide (99.998%), and aluminum isopropoxide (98+%) was added and stirred until homogenization occurred. Then the ammonium fluoride (98+%) was added, and the mixture was stirred until the desired composition was reached. The general formula of the gel composition was: xGeO2:(1-x)SiO2:yAl2O3:zMSPTOH:zNH4F:wH2O. The zeolite products obtained were ITQ-21, ITQ-30, or amorphous material depending on synthesis conditions.
property mapping:
Si/Ge: Silicon to Germanium ratio
Al/(Si+Ge): Aluminum to (Silicon+Germanium) ratio
MSPT/(Si+Ge): N(16)-methyl-sparteinium to (Silicon+Germanium) ratio
F/(Si+Ge): Fluoride to (Silicon+Germanium) ratio
H2O/(Si+Ge): Water to (Silicon+Germanium) ratio
Time (days): Crystallization time in days
MSPTOH: N(16)-methyl-sparteinium hydroxide (structure directing agent)
NH4F: Ammonium fluoride (source of fluoride)
formula abbreviations:
MSPT = N(16)-methyl-sparteinium (structure directing agent)
MSPTOH = N(16)-methyl-sparteinium hydroxide
F refers to fluoride ions, provided as NH4F (ammonium fluoride)
The general formula of the gel is: xGeO2:(1-x)SiO2:yAl2O3:zMSPTOH:zNH4F:wH2O, where x, y, z, and w are molar ratios
ratio calculations:
For the first set of experiments (Table 1):
Case 1: Si/Ge = 15, means Si = 1, Ge = 1/15 = 0.0667
Case 2: Si/Ge = 20, means Si = 1, Ge = 1/20 = 0.05
Case 3: Si/Ge = 25, means Si = 1, Ge = 1/25 = 0.04
Case 4: Si/Ge = 50, means Si = 1, Ge = 1/50 = 0.02

Al/(Si+Ge) = 0.02, 0.04, or 0.067 with Si+Ge = 1, so Al = 0.02, 0.04, or 0.067

MSPT/(Si+Ge) = 0.25 or 0.5 with Si+Ge = 1, so MSPT = 0.25 or 0.5

F/(Si+Ge) = 0.25 or 0.5 with Si+Ge = 1, so F = 0.25 or 0.5

H2O/(Si+Ge) = 2, 5, or 10 with Si+Ge = 1, so H2O = 2, 5, or 10

For the second set of experiments (Table 2):
Si/Ge = ∞ means pure silicon, so Si = 1, Ge = 0
